options.content: Chart-only path from the latest target orderbook to per-step filters and the final placed/canceled exchange commands. Narrow exchange, symbol, and actor when reading one ladder.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_book AS (
  SELECT e.ts,
         e.exchange,
         e.symbol,
         e.actor_id,
         e.payload
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = '${target_books_topic}'
    AND e.event_type = 'JointTargetBook'
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  ORDER BY e.ts DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
orders AS (
  SELECT CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END AS side,
         CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS price,
         CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS qty
  FROM latest_book lb
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES ('local', lb.payload->'local'), ('global', lb.payload->'global')
  ) AS book(role, value)
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(book.value->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) AS o(value)
  WHERE book.value IS NOT NULL
    AND ('${target_role}' = 'all' OR book.role = '${target_role}')
),
bid_depth AS (
  SELECT 'bid'::text AS side,
         price,
         SUM(qty) OVER (ORDER BY price DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS value
  FROM orders
  WHERE side = 'bid'
    AND price IS NOT NULL
    AND qty > 0
),
ask_depth AS (
  SELECT 'ask'::text AS side,
         price,
         SUM(qty) OVER (ORDER BY price ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS value
  FROM orders
  WHERE side = 'ask'
    AND price IS NOT NULL
    AND qty > 0
)
SELECT side, price, value
FROM bid_depth
UNION ALL
SELECT side, price, value
FROM ask_depth
ORDER BY side, price

WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001))
  ) AS "time"
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT metric
  FROM (
    VALUES
      ('raw ladder'),
      ('venue-valid ladder'),
      ('capped target'),
      ('target book'),
      ('risk-passed target'),
      ('kept live orders'),
      ('new order candidates'),
      ('exchange-rule valid'),
      ('exchange accepted')
  ) AS m(metric)
),
data AS (
SELECT
  to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
  stage.metric,
  SUM(stage.value) AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  VALUES
    ('raw ladder', CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','ladder','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','ladder','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END),
    ('venue-valid ladder', CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','venue_quantized','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','venue_quantized','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END),
    ('capped target', CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','capped','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','capped','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END),
    ('target book', CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','target_book','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','target_book','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END),
    ('risk-passed target', CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','risk_approved_target','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','risk_approved_target','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END),
    ('kept live orders', CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','kept','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','kept','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END),
    ('new order candidates', CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','planned_place','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','planned_place','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END),
    ('exchange-rule valid', CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','rules_valid','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','rules_valid','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END),
    ('exchange accepted', CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','router_accepted','order_count'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','router_accepted','order_count'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END)
) AS stage(metric, value)
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT b."time", m.metric, COALESCE(d.value, 0.0) AS value
FROM buckets b
CROSS JOIN metrics m
LEFT JOIN data d
  ON d."time" = b."time"
 AND d.metric = m.metric
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001))
  ) AS "time"
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         (stages.stage_label || ': ' || reason.key) AS metric
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
    ('ladder', 'raw ladder'),
    ('venue_quantized', 'venue limits'),
    ('capped', 'per-side cap'),
    ('risk_approved_target', 'risk'),
    ('rules_valid', 'exchange rules'),
    ('router_accepted', 'router')
  ) AS stages(stage, stage_label)
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(COALESCE(
    e.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', stages.stage, 'rejection_counts'],
    CASE
      WHEN stages.stage = 'risk_approved_target'
      THEN e.payload #> ARRAY['risk','rejection_counts']
      ELSE NULL::jsonb
    END,
    '{}'::jsonb
  )) AS reason(key, value)
  WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
  UNION
  SELECT 'no filter reasons'::text AS metric
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM mm_events e
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      VALUES
    ('ladder', 'raw ladder'),
    ('venue_quantized', 'venue limits'),
    ('capped', 'per-side cap'),
    ('risk_approved_target', 'risk'),
    ('rules_valid', 'exchange rules'),
    ('router_accepted', 'router')
    ) AS stages(stage, stage_label)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(COALESCE(
    e.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', stages.stage, 'rejection_counts'],
    CASE
      WHEN stages.stage = 'risk_approved_target'
      THEN e.payload #> ARRAY['risk','rejection_counts']
      ELSE NULL::jsonb
    END,
    '{}'::jsonb
  )) AS reason(key, value)
    WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
  )
),
data AS (
SELECT
  to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
  (stages.stage_label || ': ' || reason.key) AS metric,
  SUM(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(reason.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(reason.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END) AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  VALUES
    ('ladder', 'raw ladder'),
    ('venue_quantized', 'venue limits'),
    ('capped', 'per-side cap'),
    ('risk_approved_target', 'risk'),
    ('rules_valid', 'exchange rules'),
    ('router_accepted', 'router')
) AS stages(stage, stage_label)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(COALESCE(
    e.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', stages.stage, 'rejection_counts'],
    CASE
      WHEN stages.stage = 'risk_approved_target'
      THEN e.payload #> ARRAY['risk','rejection_counts']
      ELSE NULL::jsonb
    END,
    '{}'::jsonb
  )) AS reason(key, value)
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT b."time", m.metric, COALESCE(d.value, 0.0) AS value
FROM buckets b
CROSS JOIN metrics m
LEFT JOIN data d
  ON d."time" = b."time"
 AND d.metric = m.metric
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001))
  ) AS "time"
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT metric
  FROM (
    VALUES ('placed orders'), ('canceled order ids')
  ) AS m(metric)
),
data AS (
SELECT "time", metric, SUM(value) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
         'placed orders'::text AS metric,
         COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(e.payload->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) AS o(value)
  WHERE e.event_type = 'PlaceOrdersAccepted'
    AND COALESCE(o.value->>'exchange', e.exchange, '') = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND COALESCE(o.value->>'symbol', e.symbol, '') = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
         'canceled order ids'::text AS metric,
         SUM(jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(e.payload->'order_ids', '[]'::jsonb)))::double precision AS value
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.event_type = 'CancelOrdersAccepted'
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND (e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR e.symbol IS NULL)
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) commands
GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT b."time", m.metric, COALESCE(d.value, 0.0) AS value
FROM buckets b
CROSS JOIN metrics m
LEFT JOIN data d
  ON d."time" = b."time"
 AND d.metric = m.metric
ORDER BY 1, 2
